name: AnswerGap
promise: See which brand the AI recommends for your buyers' questions, and what to publish to change it.
suggested: Which brand gets cited most for our category?
Which questions are we absent from?
how_it_works: You enter three domains; the server crawls them politely (robots.txt honoured).
Every page becomes a resource in one Knowledge Box, labelled with its domain.
The Knowledge Box proposes 20 buyer questions from the combined content (JSON schema).
Each question is asked once; the cited sources decide who wins it.
Questions with no citation from your domain are your content gaps.
